description: This class, PocketDataValidator, provides validation logic for JSON data related to account linking and delinking operations within the 'self pockets' feature of the Fineract project. It validates JSON structure, required parameters, and account types, incorporating helper classes for JSON parsing and validation error handling.

classes.name: PocketDataValidator
classes.description: A service class responsible for validating JSON input data for linking and delinking account operations in the self pockets feature.

methods.name: validateForLinkingAccounts
methods.description: Validates JSON data for linking accounts, ensuring required parameters like account ID and type are present and correct.

methods.name: validateForDeLinkingAccounts
methods.description: Validates JSON data for delinking accounts, verifying the presence and correctness of account mappings.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a data validation exception if any validation errors were accumulated during validation.
